extracted.name: Strawberry Romaine Salad
extracted.description: This colorful strawberry romaine salad with spinach is served with a homemade sweet, creamy, and tangy poppy seed dressing.
ingredient_lines: 1 head romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried, and chopped
2 bunches fresh spinach - chopped, washed and dried
instruction_lines: Combine romaine, spinach, strawberries, and sliced onion in a large salad bowl.
Combine mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, milk and poppy seeds in a jar with a tight fitting lid; shake well. Pour dressing over salad and toss until evenly coated.
